lpdh.title: Lady Patricia Dream Homes
lpdh.overview: Presentation-focused website for a real estate agent, designed to improve credibility, capture leads, and showcase property listings from both her brokerage (via IDX) and personal inventory.
keyFeatures: Integrated IDX API to display live brokerage listings
Custom listings managed via Contentful CMS
Guided flow to help users navigate buying/renting paths
Lead capture through contact forms and clear CTAs (spam protected)
Fully responsive, mobile-first design
technicalHighlights: Server-side data fetching via Next.js API routes for listing data
Headless CMS setup with Contentful, including custom content modeling for listings
Internationalization using next-intl (English/Spanish support), using locale-based routing and implementing translated metadata for SEO per language
SEO-focused architecture with dynamic metadata per page, Open Graph tags for social sharing, structured data (JSON-LD) and sitemap generation
Performance optimization with Next.js <Image>, lazy loading media, and overhead reduction
results: Improved online presence and credibility for client
Centralized platform for showcasing listings and capturing inbound leads
lpdh.myRole: Built end-to-end 100% by me (architecture, development, CMS setup, SEO). Also created a client handoff tutorial for managing listings via Contentful.

plasma-vida.title: Plasma Vida Center
plasma-vida.overview: SEO-driven website for a health and wellness provider offering IV therapy, PRP treatments, and on-demand nursing services. Built to structure services clearly, attract organic traffic, and convert visitors into inquiries.
keyFeatures: CMS-driven product catalog (IV therapy & PRP) with dynamic pages
Filtering system (price range, category, sorting) for catalog navigation
Separate service pages for nursing offerings (elderly care, post-hospital, etc.)
WhatsApp-first conversion flow with pre-filled messages
Promotional carousel highlighting discounted products
technicalHighlights: Fully headless CMS architecture using Contentful (custom content modeling for products/services)
Dynamic page generation with metadata per product/service (SEO-focused)
Programmatic SEO structure with individual pages for each product/service, clean URL hierarchy, clean and intentional HTML optimized for crawling, Open Graph + structured data (JSON-LD)
Custom filtering logic for catalog (client-side UI + CMS data)
Carousel animated with Motion displaying discounted items, detecting discounts from CMS data
Performance optimizations with Next.js <Image> and lazy loading and lightweight animation resulting in fast load times
results: Structured foundation for organic SEO growth
Clear service segmentation improves user navigation and understanding
High-intent conversion flow optimized for WhatsApp-based inquiries
plasma-vida.myRole: Full build (architecture, development, CMS setup, SEO implementation, and copywriting). Delivered client handoff with CMS training for ongoing content management.

dwm.title: DWM Designs
dwm.description: Website for a centralized brand hub
dwm.overview: Multi-venture brand hub website designed to unify and present several small businesses under a single umbrella, providing clear navigation, prioritization, and conversion paths for each.
keyFeatures: Centralized landing page showcasing multiple ventures
Hero slideshow with logos and direct CTAs per business
Fully responsive design across devices
Priority highlighting for flooring services (primary revenue focus)
Separate informational page for flooring services with conversion-focused CTA
technicalHighlights: Responsive grid system for flexible, visually distinct content sections
Lightweight animations for improved UX without performance impact
Pre-filled email CTAs for streamlined user inquiries
results: Simplified presentation of multiple ventures into a single, cohesive experience
Clear user pathways reduce confusion and improve engagement
Prioritized service (flooring) receives focused visibility and conversion flow
dwm.myRole: Full build (structure, design, development, and UX decisions)

chess-by-me.title: Chess By Me
chess-by-me.description: Browser game of chess with functioning rules and clock
chess-by-me.overview: Fully playable chess game built from scratch using the HTML canvas API, focusing on accurate rule enforcement, game state management, and real-time interaction without external libraries. Fully envisioned and written by me without outside help or inspiration.
keyFeatures: Complete implementation of chess rules, with legal move validation, check / checkmate detection, castling, en passant, promotion
Drag-and-drop piece interaction with visual feedback
Legal move highlighting (valid vs invalid states)
Real-time move notation log (standard algebraic notation)
Local multiplayer (same device)
technicalHighlights: Board representation using a 2D array with piece instances (Piece class)
Move generation pipeline: each piece computes pseudo-legal moves, then moves are filtered via simulation to ensure king safety
Check detection system handling complex constraints (pinned pieces, multiple checks)
Canvas rendering where board state is mapped to pixel coordinates in real time
challenges: Designing a performant move validation system without excessive recursion
Handling edge cases like pinned pieces and multi-source checks
Keeping rendering and game logic in sync in a real-time loop
whatDemonstrates: Ability to implement complex rule engines from scratch
Problem-solving without reliance on frameworks or external libraries
chess-by-me.myRole: Made fully by me without external libraries or code generation tools.

icounter.title: iCounter
icounter.description: Desktop app made with Python for tracking my work and earnings
icounter.overview: Desktop application built to track translation work (paid per record), automating logging, earnings calculation, and real-time productivity metrics. Designed to replace manual tracking and provide immediate feedback during work sessions.
keyFeatures: Real-time tracking of records translated and earnings
Session and sprint-based time tracking (start/stop workflow)
Live productivity metrics including records per hour, average time per record, earnings per hour, total session time and earnings
Automatic logging to Excel file
Pre-structured Excel output for persistent record keeping
technicalHighlights: Modular OOP architecture with clear separation of concerns
Unidirectional data flow: UI triggers actions, actions update state/data, state notifies UI
Observer-style pattern for UI updates via state subscriptions
Timer system that tracks session, sprint, and per-record timing concurrently
challenges: Maintaining accurate time-based metrics across overlapping timers (session vs sprint vs per-letter)
Designing a clean interaction model between UI, state, and data layers
Ensuring real-time stat updates without introducing inconsistency
Handling Excel formatting and reliable append-based persistence
whatDemonstrates: Ability to design clean, modular architectures in a desktop environment
Strong understanding of state management and data flow patterns
Practical application of automation to eliminate manual workflows
Building tools tailored to actual user needs

HomePage.h1-1: Hi, I'm Samuel, front-end web developer.
HomePage.h1-2: Feel free to explore my work.

AboutPage.overview: I'm a developer who doesn't just write functional code, but understands the systems behind it. I enjoy building applications with more complex logic, things that go beyond surface-level UI and require real thinking under the hood. While I work primarily on the frontend, I write code I fully understand from architecture down to implementation, and I'm comfortable stepping outside my core stack to solve problems wherever they appear.
AboutPage.howIThinkOverview: I approach development with a focus on structure, clarity, and understanding. Before building, I like to define how things should work at a system level, so the end result is scalable, maintainable, and easy to reason about.
AboutPage.structureFirstText: I start by defining architecture and reusable patterns early, so I can avoid unnecessary work later and keep things consistent as projects grow.
AboutPage.understandDeeplyText: I don't rely on black-box solutions. If I use something, I make sure I understand how it works, from high-level behavior down to underlying logic when needed.
AboutPage.debuggingText: When something breaks, I break the problem down. I isolate each part of the system step by step until the root cause becomes obvious.
AboutPage.usableText: I focus on building interfaces that are clear and user-friendly. My design supports the product, it doesn't distract from it.
AboutPage.currentFocusText: I'm currently focused on freelance work, primarily building marketing websites and content-driven applications that are designed to convert and scale.
AboutPage.projectStructuring: Strong on structuring projects and turning ideas into real applications
AboutPage.reliableIndependent: Reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently

ContactPage.overview: I'm currently available for freelance projects. Feel free to reach out.
